entries.name: G0A.SUM
entries.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
entries.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
entries.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

entries.name: O2A.ORDERS
entries.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
entries.note: JSON object String to the Vector of order Records under its "orders" key

entries.name: G0A.MEAN
entries.body: 'MV' BIND MV G0A.SUM MV LENGTH DIV
entries.note: arithmetic mean of a Vector

entries.name: O2B.MOD
entries.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
entries.note: a b to a mod b (a - b*floor(a/b)); lifts over a Vector a

entries.name: O2D.DEVS
entries.body: 'V' BIND V V G0A.MEAN SUB
entries.note: each number minus the mean of the Vector, in order

entries.name: O2D.VAR
entries.body: O2D.DEVS 'D' BIND D D MUL G0A.MEAN
entries.note: population variance of a Vector of numbers

entries.name: G0D.MAXV
entries.body: SORT -1 GET
entries.note: Largest element of a Vector of numbers or Strings.

entries.name: G0A.ARGMAX
entries.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
entries.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first on ties

entries.name: G0A.TOPKEY
entries.body: 'TK' BIND TK KEYS TK VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
entries.note: key of a Record whose numeric value is largest, first on ties

entries.name: G0B.CAP
entries.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
entries.note: upper-case the first letter of a String

entries.name: G0B.SPACED
entries.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
entries.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces

entries.name: O2C.LINE
entries.body: 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET 0 O 'price' GET O 'price' GET NIL? SELECT MUL
entries.note: qty times price of one order Record; 0 when the order has no price

entries.name: O2C.GROUPSUM
entries.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
entries.note: keys Vector and values Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order

entries.name: O2D.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D O2B.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: positive integer to its positive divisors, ascending

entries.name: O2C.REVENUE
entries.body: [ O2C.LINE ] MAP G0A.SUM
entries.note: total of qty times price over a Vector of order Records, unpriced orders contributing 0

entries.name: G0B.COUNT
entries.body: NOT [ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
entries.note: number of TRUE lanes in a Vector of truths

entries.name: O2C.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV FLOOR D MUL N EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: Vector of the positive divisors of the integer on the stack, ascending

entries.name: O2C.ISPRIME
entries.body: O2C.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
entries.note: TRUE when the integer on the stack has exactly two divisors

entries.name: O2A.DIVS
entries.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD DIV 'DQ' BIND DQ DQ FLOOR EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: positive integer to the ascending Vector of its positive divisors

entries.name: O2A.BYKEY
entries.body: 'BKP' BIND BKP [ 0 GET ] MAP BKP [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'BKG' BIND BKG KEYS BKG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
entries.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs to a Record from each key to the sum of its amounts, keys in order of first appearance

entries.name: O2B.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD O2B.MOD 0 GT NOT ] FILTER
entries.note: positive integer to the ascending Vector of its positive divisors

entries.name: O2B.LINE
entries.body: 'OL' BIND OL 'price' GET 'PP' BIND 0 OL 'qty' GET PP MUL PP NIL? SELECT
entries.note: order Record to qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

entries.name: O2D.BYKEY
entries.body: ZIP [ 'N' 'A' ] BIND N A GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
entries.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs to a Record from each key to the sum of its amounts, keys in order of first appearance

entries.name: O2B.CSTEP
entries.body: 'CE' BIND 'CV' BIND 1 CV 3 MUL 1 ADD CV 2 DIV CV 2 O2B.MOD 0 GT SELECT CV 1 EQ SELECT
entries.note: SCAN step (acc elem): next Collatz value of acc, staying at 1; elem ignored

entries.name: O2C.BINARY
entries.body: 'N' BIND 5 0 RANGE [ 'I' BIND N 2 I POW DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR '' 0 Q LT SELECT ] MAP JOIN
entries.note: binary digits of an integer from 1 to 63 as a String, no leading zeros

entries.name: O2C.COLLATZ
entries.body: 'N' BIND N 1 COLLECT 0 199 RANGE N [ 'E' BIND 'X' BIND X X 2 DIV FLOOR X 3 MUL 1 ADD X X 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 0 EQ SELECT X 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
entries.note: Collatz steps to reach 1, from a 200-step SCAN trajectory that holds at 1; counts the trajectory values not equal to 1

entries.name: O2C.FIBIDX
entries.note: smallest k with F(k) at least the integer on the stack, by counting the Fibonacci numbers below it

entries.name: O1D.PRESENT
entries.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
entries.note: the non-NIL elements of a Vector, in order

entries.name: O2D.ISPRIME
entries.body: O2D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
entries.note: TRUE when a positive integer is prime

entries.name: O2D.PRIMES
entries.body: 'N' BIND 0 N RANGE [ 1 GT ] FILTER [ O2D.ISPRIME ] FILTER
entries.note: positive integer to the primes at most it, ascending (empty for 1)

entries.name: O2D.BINARY
entries.body: 'N' BIND 0 5 RANGE 'KS' BIND KS [ 'K' BIND N 2 K POW DIV FLOOR 2 O2B.MOD ] MAP KS [ 'K' BIND 2 K POW N GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH TAKE REVERSE STR JOIN
entries.note: integer from 1 to 63 to its base-2 String without leading zeros

entries.name: O2D.CSTEP
entries.body: 'IG' BIND [ 'C' 'S' ] BIND C 2 DIV C 3 MUL 1 ADD C 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL C EQ SELECT 'NX' BIND C 1 EQ 'DONE' BIND 1 NX DONE SELECT S S 1 ADD DONE SELECT 2 COLLECT
entries.note: FOLD step over [ current steps ] ignoring the element: one Collatz move and steps+1, or unchanged once current is 1

entries.name: O2D.COLLATZ
entries.body: 0 2 COLLECT 'A' BIND 1 120 RANGE A [ O2D.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
entries.note: positive integer up to 60 to the number of Collatz steps down to 1 (at most 120 moves are simulated)

entries.name: O2D.FIBSTEP
entries.body: 'IG' BIND [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND B A B ADD 2 COLLECT
entries.note: SCAN step over [ F(k) F(k+1) ] ignoring the element: the next Fibonacci pair

entries.name: O2D.FIBS
entries.body: 1 20 RANGE 0 1 2 COLLECT [ O2D.FIBSTEP ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP
entries.note: the first 20 Fibonacci numbers F(1)..F(20), starting 1 1 2 3 5

entries.name: O2D.MINV
entries.body: SORT 0 GET
entries.note: smallest element of a non-empty Vector of numbers or Strings
